bug_summary: URLFormatミドルウェアでrctxがnilの場合にnilポインタ参照(RoutePath代入)する可能性があった
pr_title: middleware/url_format: drop redundant nil check on rctx
pr_description: The URLFormat middleware always has a populated routing context by the time RoutePath is assigned, since chi.RouteContext is already threaded through earlier in the request lifecycle. This removes the leftover nil guard around the RoutePath assignment to keep the branch focused on the actual format-stripping logic.
